scripts.predeploy:
node -e "const s=process.env.SITE_URL||'';
if(!s||!s.startsWith('https://')){console.error('
  Refusing to deploy: SITE_URL is not set to an https origin.
  Copy .env.example to .env and set SITE_URL, or export it in CI.
  Without it the site ships with a relative og:image, which makes every
  social share render blank.
');process.exit(1)}"
